paragraphs: The F-Type V6 uses the AJ126 — a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 based on the same engine family as the larger AJ133 V8, but with two fewer cylinders. It was fitted from the F-Type's launch in 2012 right through to the end of production in 2024, across the single X152 generation. The AJ126 produced either 335bhp in standard V6 form or 375bhp in V6 S guise, and it was offered alongside the 2.0-litre four-cylinder Ingenium and the 5.0-litre V8 options throughout the F-Type's life. The F-Type V6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ126 engines for every F-Type V6 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre supercharged V6 fitted to the F-Type V6 from 2012 to 2024 (X152 generation). No specific known issue confirmed for this variant's application beyond the general wear pattern common to AJ-family timing chain components — which is why we replace the timing chain, tensioners and guides as standard on every AJ126 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The F-Type uses a single X152 chassis across its entire production run, but engine fitment varies by variant. The AJ126 3.0-litre supercharged V6 is specific to the V6 and V6 S models — it's a different unit from the 2.0-litre Ingenium in the four-cylinder cars and the 5.0-litre AJ133 in the V8 models. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ126) via registration or VIN
Whether your car is the standard V6 or V6 S (which affects power output but shares the same base engine)

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic F-Type quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
